fixed.summary: The drawn sea is the sea bodies float on: the surface rises only with the waves og.physics.waterHeight and og.Buoyancy evaluate, which now reach down to a metre (48 waves, where 32 stopped at a 32nd of the peak's length: 2.6 m at 10 m/s, 10 m at 20 m/s). The shorter ripples the renderer adds shade the surface and no longer move it; they stood 2 cm RMS off the floated sea at 10 m/s and 14 cm in a gale. A body's motion on a sea differs from the version before.

The waves' crest lean is shared so the long waves lean whole and the sum still never folds: a sea of the same choppiness keeps sharp crests with more, shorter waves under them. Every reference frame of a sea moves.
